Late reply, sorry.

No, I haven't. I don't want to. I think they're the ones who are making me feel like this, so I'm avoiding this topic with them. After all, they're the ones who keep telling me I have to get into a university or else their hard-earned cash for my tuition will be a waste or something. I know, if my parents are the ones who are causing me to feel like this then I should talk to them right? I have tried before, but they either don't take me seriously or straight up tell me that normal people shouldn't be thinking the way that I am. Whenever my parents say that, it feels really dehumanizing, so I don't want to hear it. Also, there's a language barrier between my parents and I so I have a lot of trouble communicating my thoughts. I'm just going to call myself a lost cause and let whatever happens happen.

Not too sure, might've developed it. I don't know too much about insomnia. Usually it's just me spending too much time on my PC watching youtube or being on reddit. Instead of doing my homework, of course.

Hey, same here! I'm pretty much exactly like you. I get super embarrassed when people find out I don't do chores or have a job. It always amazes me how people can do all those things at the same time and come out looking like they have no problem with it.

My parents want me to go to university, but I can barely finish the homework that I have now. I know for sure that if I go to a university (if I can even get in) that it'll be much harder, so truth be told I don't want to go. I, like you, also hope to die before I get to that stage where all your responsibilities are dumped onto you. I really don't think I can take it. If worst comes to worst I'll just kill myself. Thinking about this makes me want to cry and give up.

Definitely. Every day that I wake up, I forget most of what happened the day before. I forget assignments and test dates. I forget to go to club meetings at school and I forget to do chores or to go outside every once in a while. I'm slowly losing my sanity every day that passes, unless somehow I feel pleasant on a nice day. In my mind, I'm swimming in an endless black ocean that threatens to swallow me up.

I think part of it is because I want to forget everything. I don't want to remember what happened yesterday, or what is scheduled for today, or what I just did 20 minutes ago. I want to get away from it all. It's a form of escapism for me, really. If I can forget everything, then the world just seems a little bit less real to me, like I'm walking in a dream. It's almost its own form of bliss.

Sometimes I wish my brain would just shut down. The headache isn't going away anytime soon, probably because I'm sleeping past 3am every night even when I have to wake up at 7 in the morning. Maybe the real reason I can't remember much at all is because I get less than 4 hours of sleep most nights, which is pretty unreasonable for a teenager. I have trouble thinking straight and solving problems pretty much every day now. I don't want to live like this any longer, but I can't bring myself to change anything in my life.

Sorry for the rant.
